text: Two problems were identified: the screen/display is missing and kickoff participation shows gaps in preparation and coordination.
Decisions set pricing at 25 Euros, a sales target of 50 million Euros, and production cost at half the selling price.
The project will begin with phase one focused on functional design, with a TV/video oriented system and potential future features, emphasizing user-friendly design and the least number of functions.

Action owners and responsibilities were defined: Industrial Designer for conceptual design and design-phase overview; Project Manager to summarize items; Marketing Expert to perform internet searches and user interviews.
